scripts.lint: uv run --frozen --extra dev ruff check e2b_adk tests examples
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.postVersion: uv version --frozen $(pnpm pkg get version | tr -d '"')
scripts.release: rm -rf dist && uv build && uv publish --trusted-publishing always --check-url https://pypi.org/simple/
